title: Screening of Natural Compounds for CYP11A1 Stimulation Against Renal Cell Carcinoma
author: Ong, Ates, et al.
materials: CYP11A1 cDNA, cloned in a pCMV-SPORT5 vector
primary antibodies against CYP11A1, Beclin1, and LC3A/B

Protein samples were separated using one-dimensional 12% Tris–glycine SDS-PAGE, and the proteins were transferred onto nitrocellulose membranes (Bio-Rad, CA, USA). The membrane was blocked by incubating in 5% skim milk in 1X TBS with 0.5% Tween 20 for 1 h and then washed with 1X TBST. The membranes were incubated overnight with primary antibodies diluted 1:1000 (v:v) in 5% BSA at 4 °C in the dark. After washing three times with TBST for 5 min each time, the membranes were incubated with horseradish peroxidase-conjugated secondary antibody (MA, USA) in 5% skim milk (1:5000 v:v diluted) at room temperature for 1 h. The blots were detected using a chemiluminescence SignalFire™ ECL Reagent from Cell Signaling Technology (MA, USA) with an Ez-Capture MG system ATTO (NY, USA). The relative intensities of the western blot bands were measured using the ImageJ software (MD, USA). The GAPDH antibody was used as a loading control.

steps.title: Screen natural compounds in wound‑healing assay
steps.instruction: Test a library of 1 374 natural compounds on CYP11A1‑transfected Caki‑1 cells using a wound‑healing migration assay; select the 167 compounds that inhibit migration by >75 %, determine IC₅₀ for each (159 compounds), and retain the 38 compounds with IC₅₀ < 50 µM for downstream analysis of steroid hormone levels by LC‑MS/MS and mechanistic western‑blot studies.

steps.title: Prepare CYP11A1 plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate CYP11A1 cDNA plasmid with a plasmid midi kit (manufacturer’s protocol), measure DNA concentration on a NanoDrop spectrophotometer, and store the purified plasmid for transfection.

steps.title: Culture and transfect Caki‑1 cells
steps.instruction: Maintain Caki‑1 cells in DMEM‑high glucose supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum and 1 % penicillin/streptomycin; incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, humidified atmosphere. When cells are in logarithmic growth phase, transiently transfect them with the CYP11A1 plasmid using Lipofectamine 3000 according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Collect cells and quantify protein
steps.instruction: Harvest cells in cold PBS, wash twice with cold PBS, lyse in RIPA buffer containing a protease and phosphatase inhibitor cocktail, incubate on ice at 4 °C for 20 min with vortexing every 7 min, centrifuge 20 min at 14 000 × g, 4 °C, collect supernatant, and determine protein concentration with the Pierce™ BCA Protein Assay Kit following the kit protocol.

steps.title: Extract steroids from culture media
steps.instruction: Collect culture‑medium (CM) samples, add ethyl acetate to CM at a 5:1 (v/v) ratio, vortex 1 min, shake on a rotator for 30 min, centrifuge at 1 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, transfer the organic (ethyl acetate) layer to a clean tube, freeze at –80 °C, repeat the extraction two additional times, pool all organic extracts, evaporate to dryness under a nitrogen stream, and store the dried residue at –20 °C until LC‑MS/MS analysis.

steps.title: Prepare LC‑MS/MS system and run samples
steps.instruction: Set up a UHPLC‑MS/MS system (LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro) with a CORTECS C18 column (90 Å, 2.7 µm, 2.1 × 50 mm, Waters). Maintain column oven at 40 °C, inject 10 µL per run. Use isopropanol (or 0.1 % formic acid in water) as mobile phase A and B respectively, flow rate 0.4 mL min⁻¹, and apply the gradient: 0 min 0 % A/0 % B, 1 min 75 % A/25 % B, 2.5 min 0 % A/0 % B, 6 min 0 % A/0 % B, 7.5 min 10 % A/0 % B, 8 min 10 % A/0 % B, 10 min 0 % A/0 % B (all at 0.4 mL min⁻¹). Operate the mass spectrometer in positive electrospray ionization mode, spray voltage +3.9 kV, collision energy 35 eV, using full‑scan or multiple‑reaction monitoring. Monitor the following transitions: cholesterol (m/z 369.35 → 243.15, CE 56.67 eV, RT 5.0 min), pregnenolone (m/z 299.26 → 281.23, CE 54.49 eV, RT 5.0 min), and finasteride (internal standard, 10 ng mL⁻¹; m/z 373.28 → 305.22, CE 54.14 eV, RT 5.0 min). Inject the dried extracts reconstituted in the appropriate mobile phase and acquire data.

steps.title: Validate LC‑MS/MS quantitation method
steps.instruction: Prepare calibration standards of cholesterol and pregnenolone at 0.05, 0.1, 1, 10, and 25 µg mL⁻¹ (six concentrations total) spiked into cell‑culture medium, adding finasteride at 10 ng mL⁻¹ as internal standard. Extract standards as described above and construct calibration curves (linearity 0.9995 for pregnenolone, 0.9999 for cholesterol). Determine recovery as mean extracted‑area ÷ standard‑area × 100 %. Assess LOD (S/N = 3) and LOQ (S/N = 10) using five replicates of low‑concentration samples (LOD 0.001–0.0014 ng mL⁻¹; LOQ 0.004 ng mL⁻¹ for cholesterol, 0.03 ng mL⁻¹ for pregnenolone). Evaluate accuracy (% measured/theoretical at 1 and 10 µg mL⁻¹) and precision (CV % of triplicates). Perform intra‑day (n = 3) and inter‑day (n = 3) assessments for both steroids (cholesterol intra‑day CV 2 %, inter‑day CV 11.3 %; pregnenolone intra‑day CV 3–3.9 %, inter‑day CV 3.9–4.2 %).

steps.title: Perform western blot for target proteins
steps.instruction: Separate protein samples on a 12 % Tris‑glycine SDS‑PAGE gel, transfer onto a nitrocellulose membrane (Bio‑Rad). Block membrane in 5 % skim milk in 1X TBS containing 0.5 % Tween‑20 for 1 h at room temperature, then wash with 1X TBST. Incubate overnight at 4 °C in the dark with primary antibodies diluted 1:1000 in 5 % BSA. Wash three times with TBST (5 min each). Incubate 1 h at room temperature with HRP‑conjugated secondary antibody diluted 1:5000 in 5 % skim milk. Detect signals using SignalFire™ ECL reagent (Cell Signaling Technology) and capture images with an Ez‑Capture MG system (ATTO). Quantify band intensities with ImageJ software, using GAPDH as a loading control.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate CYP11A1 from lysates
steps.instruction: Take cell‑lysate containing 500 µg total protein (protein concentration 1 mg mL⁻¹). Pre‑clear lysate by adding 50 µL Protein A/G agarose bead slurry, rotate 60 min at 4 °C, then centrifuge 10 min at 4 °C and transfer supernatant to a fresh tube. Add primary anti‑CYP11A1 antibody diluted 1:50 (v/v) to the pre‑cleared lysate and incubate overnight with rotation at 4 °C. Add 50 µL Protein A/G agarose bead slurry, rotate 1–3 h at 4 °C, centrifuge 30 s at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and wash the bead pellet five times with 500 µL 1X cell‑lysis buffer (keep on ice between washes). Elute bound proteins by SDS‑PAGE sample buffer and proceed to western blotting.

steps.title: Analyze data statistically
steps.instruction: Express all quantitative results as mean ± standard deviation of three independent replicates. Perform one‑way ANOVA followed by Dunnett’s multiple‑comparison test using GraphPad Prism v8.0.0 (Windows). Consider *p ≤ 0.05, **p ≤ 0.01, ***p ≤ 0.0001, ****p ≤ 0.0001 as statistically significant.
